info.name: AbsoluteCinema API
info.description:
Visi AbsoluteCinema API metodai su testais. Paleidimas: Collection → Run (arba `npx newman run`).
Hierarchija: Studija → Filmas → Recenzija. Žetonai: access (JWT, Bearer antraštėje) + refresh (HttpOnly slapukas).

item.name: 0. Setup – log in demo users
item.description: Logs in the seeded admin and two members and stores their access tokens.

exec: pm.test("role in token is admin", () => { const p = JSON.parse(require("atob")(body.access_token.split(".")[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"))); pm.expect(p.role).to.eql("admin"); pm.expect(p.sub).to.be.a("string"); });

item.description: Studio is the top of the hierarchy: Studio → Movie → Review.

item.description: Movies are scoped to their studio: /studios/{studio}/movies/{movie}.

item.name: Catalog: all movies filtered (genre, years, rating) → 200

exec: pm.test("all sci-fi with rating ≥ 8", () => body.data.forEach(m => { pm.expect(m.genre).to.eql("sci-fi"); pm.expect(m.average_rating).to.be.at.least(8); }));

item.name: 3. Reviews – CRUD (hierarchical)
item.description: Reviews live under /studios/{studio}/movies/{movie}/reviews – the hierarchical endpoints cover all 3 objects.

item.name: 5. Auth – register, refresh, logout
item.description: JWT access token (15 min) + refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie (14 days).

item.name: 6. Two-factor authentication (bonus)
item.description: TOTP 2FA: enable → confirm → login needs a code → disable.

exec: // TOTP (RFC 6238) code from the secret – the same thing Google Authenticator does
for (let i = 0; i + 8 <= bits.length; i += 8) keyHex += parseInt(bits.substr(i, 8), 2).toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
